payload.unknowns: 这些平均值显示先降后升，但不能说明变化是否持续，也不能证明减盐导致了变化；记录没有提供每日读数或其他可能影响血压的情况。
payload.what_changed: 记录显示，家庭血压7日平均从7月的132/84降至8月的126/80，9月又升至135/86；记录称使用同一上臂袖带、早晨坐位测量。
payload.why_now: 新的同类7日平均值与此前“持续下降、减盐可能有效”的判断方向相反，需要修正对趋势的认识。

judge.reason: Surfaces the new September 135/86 average, compares it with the same-protocol July and August averages, and explicitly corrects the earlier downward-trend assessment. It does not claim salt caused the change and identifies continued same-condition measurements as a way to judge whether the trend persists. Nothing was previously surfaced on this question.
